scope: Second video-banner review: code, cancellation, local disk lifetime, GIF conversion, audio thread, iPhone/iPad presentation

findings.issue: Draft files survived editor dismissal; imported source was deleted prematurely on navigation away
findings.fix: Shared temporary-file ownership; preparation retains source for its entire async operation; published/cache and borrowed source files are not owned or deleted
findings.proof: Two native filesystem lifetime tests passed on iPhone and iPad simulators

findings.issue: Late download success/failure could resurrect or change a stopped/replaced player
findings.fix: Capture session token before awaiting; own and cancel pending load; reject stale results and stale surface readiness callbacks
findings.proof: Controlled delayed-response tests passed for stop/success/failure and reordered completions

findings.issue: Interruption paused the player without updating its visible pause state
findings.fix: Set paused state and retain muted explicit-resume behavior
findings.proof: Interruption during controlled pending load test passed

findings.issue: GIF decoded the same source frame repeatedly at output-frame frequency
findings.fix: Keep one decoded source image until its index changes; fill alpha with a deterministic black matte before drawing into recycled buffers
findings.proof: Actual GIF conversions passed native SDK tests and server byte inspection; no speed multiplier claimed

findings.issue: iPad iOS 27 emitted main-thread AVAudioSession activation warning
findings.fix: Dedicated serial audio queue for category/activation/deactivation; owner UUID prevents late release from deactivating a newer session; notifications delivered on main queue
findings.proof: Updated iPad sound UI tests passed without the prior warning

findings.issue: Silent video kept extra space reserved for a nonexistent speaker
findings.fix: Reserve 56pt for one control, 104pt for audio plus expand
findings.proof: Silent-video UI test passed; screenshot reviewed

findings.issue: Cancel in Files picker could be presented as an import error
findings.fix: Ignore Cocoa user cancellation before starting preparation
findings.proof: Code inspection; actual Files dialog cancellation remains a manual scenario

findings.issue: Expanded video on iPad used a central page sheet
findings.fix: Use true fullScreenCover with its own loading lifecycle and the same model; preserve post-dismiss link action; keep loading indicator out of dismissal frames
findings.proof: Full-window control-position assertion, manual autoplay-off viewing, rotation and post-dismiss navigation passed on both simulators; final screenshots reviewed

findings.issue: iOS 26.5 bottom toolbar emitted unsupported UIKitToolbar/UIHostingController hierarchy warning in fullscreen
findings.fix: Render the same controls in a SwiftUI safeAreaInset with 44pt targets and accessible labels; dark navigation-bar contrast over black video
findings.proof: Final two-device xcresult runtimeWarnings is empty; all 12 UI executions passed

intermediateChecks.iPhone: 46 Swift tests / 7 suites + 6 UI tests passed
intermediateChecks.iPad: 46 Swift tests / 7 suites + 6 UI tests passed before final fullscreen conversion

testHarnessCorrection: Fixed 900pt spacer could not scroll the full banner off the 13-inch iPad viewport; use twice the actual viewport height. Kept the stop predicate unchanged.

finalChecks.phone: 46 Swift tests / 7 suites and 6 UI tests passed on iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5
finalChecks.iPad: Same 46 Swift tests / 7 suites and 6 UI tests passed on iPad Pro 13-inch M5, iOS 27.0
finalChecks.nativeToServerContract: 4 actual native encodes accepted after final matrix: 15s/1s AAC MP4 and 1.2s/1s GIF MP4

visualLimits: Reviewed synthetic-fixture layout, controls and text, not final promotional media aesthetics
performanceLimits: Code-level reductions and simulator behavior verified; no physical FPS, CPU, memory, heat or battery measurements claimed
device: Serlest Mobile unavailable in official devicectl inventory
stillRequired: Real device Release playback, scroll with seasonal scenes, audio interruptions/routes, rotation and accessibility
Production owner import/upload/save/reopen/copy/remove after safe backend rollout
Exact-source CI readback for these new fixes
Native Mac window/media-picker validation and nonfixture source formats; simulator iPad evidence is not Mac evidence

reviewed: true full-window player on both devices
